title: Import: Package and JSON Import | Orchard Core
description:
A configuration or a set of content that you built on one Orchard Core site often has to run on another site. Rebuilding it by hand takes time and invites mistakes.

The Deployment module imports a recipe into the site you are signed in to, from a zip package or from pasted text, and runs its steps in order. This video imports a package and a recipe, explains what travels with each, and shows who is allowed to import.

In this video:
• What an import does: recipes, packages and steps
• Package Import: run a zip package
• JSON Import: paste a recipe and run it
• Package or JSON: what travels with the recipe
• When an import fails
• Who can import: the Import Data permission
